bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" are allowed, and they do not need to be clear. Backpacks are not allowed.
allowed: Bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" (straps not counted)
Fanny packs and crossbody bags within the size limit
Clear stadium bags within the size limit
prohibited: Cameras with detachable lenses, GoPros and recorders
Outside food, cans, bottles and flasks
Laser pointers, glow sticks and flashlights
Signs larger than 11" x 17" or on a stick
bagPolicy.note: No bag or coat check. Guests with prohibited items must return them to a hotel room or vehicle. Baby bags get extra screening and are tagged at entry. Artists and promoters can change the policy for their event.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at MGM Grand Garden Arena can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: At MGM Grand, rideshare drop-off is at the main entrance porte-cochere. For pickup, use the Rideshare Lounge on the ground floor of the self-parking garage, reached through the MGM Underground exit.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at MGM Grand Garden Arena varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If you are holding non-accessible seating and require accessible seating sections, please contact us to make arrangements for accessible seating as far in advance of the event as possible. If you are holding seating in an accessible section and do not require the features of this type of seating, please contact the arena Box Office to exchange your seating into a non-accessible section based on availability.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted at MGM Grand Garden Arena.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The AXS Box Office is in The District at MGM Grand and opens at 2 PM PT on event days until the event starts, though hours can vary. Will call tickets are picked up at the AXS Box Office during regular business hours.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance to MGM Grand Garden Arena is inside The District at MGM Grand. Doors for concerts generally open 60 minutes before the event.
